items.label: 버럭
items.prompt: Uga bursts into emphatic comic anger: leans forward aggressively, squeezes both fists at his sides, V-shaped sharply downward brows, eyes narrowed, mouth opens wide in an indignant shout. Arms visibly tense. No props or floating decoration.

items.label: 꾹 참는 화
items.prompt: Uga in restrained anger: drawn tightly shut straight mouth with pressed lips, furrowed brows, controlled narrowed eyes, shoulders held still, one hand grasping his opposite clenched fist in front of his chest. No yelling or steam.

items.label: 짜증
items.prompt: Mildly irritated Uga has one eyebrow pinched down and the other relaxed, heavy half-lidded eyes and a small crooked scowl. His elbow is up with two fingers pressing his temple. Exasperated, visibly softer and less intense than rage.

items.label: 억울함
items.prompt: Uga feels unfairly blamed. Inner brows high and sad; eyes pleading and mouth parted in protest. One hand pressed against his own chest and his other palm open toward the viewer, like asking to be heard.

items.label: 입 삐죽
items.prompt: Uga is playfully sulking. Turn his torso about 25 degrees away, arms visibly crossed across his chest, cheeks puffed out and lips pushed into an exaggerated side pout. He peeks back from the corner of his eyes. No tears.

items.label: 토라져서 등 돌림
items.prompt: Back three-quarter full body view, compact rounded silhouette. Uga crouches on the ground and hugs his bent knees, turns his back on the viewer, his head angled just enough that the familiar beard in profile and little protruding pout show past a shoulder. Show yellow spotted tunic from the back. No floor or props.

items.label: 서운함
items.prompt: Uga quietly disappointed and hurt, seated with hunched shoulders and head lowered, eyes pointed at the ground. A familiar ivory bone rests across his lap, held loosely, almost forgotten. No crying and no steam.

items.label: 울먹울먹
items.prompt: Upper body Uga on the brink of crying: large watery eyes with tiny drops at the lower eyelids, worried curved eyebrows, trembling small mouth, hands nervously folded together below beard. No streams of tears, restrained sadness.

items.label: 엉엉
items.prompt: Uga sits down crying hard. Shoulders hunched, both hands cover most of his face while his shaggy hair and beard remain visible, two short clean blue tear streams peeking from between hands and cheeks. Compact seated chibi silhouette.

items.label: 뜨끔
items.prompt: Uga startled because someone mentioned his own mistake. Shoulders suddenly up to his ears, eyes dart distinctly to one side, stiff arms close to sides, eyes wide and small mouth slightly open. A sheepish guilty flash, without scratching head, no accessory.

items.label: 머쓱
items.prompt: Uga awkwardly scratches the BACK of his hair with one hand, head slightly tilted and uneven sheepish little grin with one eye squinted. Loose shoulders, friendly embarrassment.

items.label: 갸우뚱
items.prompt: Skeptical Uga tilts entire head visibly to one side, shoots a sideways glance with one raised brow, one squinting eye, closed asymmetrical unimpressed mouth. Arms down, no question mark or hand under chin.

items.label: 기진맥진
items.prompt: Exhausted Uga slumped across a simple small tan stone slab, one peach cheek flattened on the edge, eyes half shut with fatigue, both arms dangling down, ivory bone droops loosely from one hand. Include stone only directly supporting him and no ground.

items.label: 휴, 다행이다
items.prompt: Relieved Uga exhales softly, one palm on his chest, eyes gently closed, brows relaxed, shoulders visibly dropped, little pursed smiling exhale. One tiny cream puff by mouth if needed. No other elements.

items.label: 빵 터짐
items.prompt: Full-body Uga cracking up with laughter, off-balance as he tips backward, hands clutching his belly, eyes squeezed shut into happy crescent shapes, open laugh, one foot kicks slightly forward. No props.

items.label: 혼자 뿌듯
items.prompt: Quietly pleased Uga stands tall, chin slightly raised, both hands resting at his hips, chest forward, eyes soft and mouth a small self-satisfied closed smile. Understated personal pride, not wild cheering.

items.label: 슬쩍 화해
items.prompt: Uga turns his torso halfway back toward us, eyebrows slightly raised with cautious hope, eyes look up, shy small smile, gently offers one SMALL ivory bone held horizontally in both palms at arm's length, peace offering.

items.label: 축하해요
items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new individual transparent reaction sticker for the Korean Uga family budget app. The input image is the official reference for the exact mascot identity, style, proportions, and sticker finish. Preserve the shaggy dark brown hair and forelock, scalloped full brown beard, peach cheeks, thick brows, yellow ochre tunic with dark irregular spots, bold near-black chocolate contours, and warm flat color fills. Square framing, large centered isolated silhouette with modest even margins. No letters, logo, badge background, white sticker border, drop shadow, floor, frame, other character, or reference prop. Real transparent background. Pose and expression: Uga celebrates with a handheld party popper. Show him beaming with a big open smile and happy crescent eyes, cheeks lifted. In one hand he holds a clearly visible small coral-and-ochre striped cone-shaped party popper tilted diagonally upward beside his head. A compact burst of 5–7 bold coral, gold and muted mint paper confetti shapes erupts directly from the open tip, positioned above and beside his head without hiding his face. His free hand is raised in delight. Keep both the cone and burst clearly inside the square and legible at 92px. Waist-up, simple uncluttered silhouette.

items.label: 끄덕끄덕
items.prompt: Attentive Uga nods his head forward, kind eyes open looking at the speaker, small calm smile, hands at rest. Two short restrained brown motion accents near top of head make the nod readable, no props.

items.label: 아하

items.label: 어느 쪽이에요?

items.label: 잠깐만요

items.label: 앗, 다시
items.prompt: Uga realizes an error and tries again. One hand scratches the back of his head with sheepish smile, the other holds up a compact parchment with a single curved undo arrow symbol. No text.

items.label: 그럴 때도 있죠

items.label: 같이 해봐요

items.label: 고마워요

items.label: 다 됐어요
items.prompt: Uga smiles with bright relaxed eyes and holds up one small rounded ivory stone tablet with a single prominent muted mint check mark. Friendly completion, without jumping or confetti, no other marks or text.

items.label: 다음에 봐요
